name: Primal Howl
text:
Frequency once per hour

---
Effect Your animal companion screeches and howls, empowered with natural magic. All creatures in a 30-foot cone take floor(@actor.level/2)d6 sonic damage for every 2 levels your companion has, with a basic Fortitude save save against your spell DC. Creatures that fail become Frightened 1, and creatures that critically fail become Frightened 2. The fright is an emotion, fear, and mental effect.
